text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold stocks at gains, then bought Stock A and Stock E back at higher prices; I should not sell just to lock in a satisfying gain, or repurchase without a fresh investment case.","I tend to judge each stock against its purchase price and resist admitting mistakes. Average cost is not a reason to hold: I should reassess the outlook and downside risk objectively.","A few profitable trades did not prevent my account value from falling in Period 4. I should evaluate total portfolio performance and risk, not just whether individual sales were winners."]}
